parimana_note: Linux numbers are 16-byte-ALIGNED requested bytes (nirmmita(1000) -> 1072 = 64 + 1008), not page counts — so a PE parimana counting the same way WOULD match the goldens, and the golden does not need changing. Current Windows result (0) is absence (unimplemented), not a different number. Caveat: if Windows' allocator rounds differently, the golden would need a platform variant AFTER implementation — not the current bug.
